hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-serif text-slate-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500 font-semibold

crystal_glass.classes: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/60 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(37,99,235,0.06)] rounded-2xl

input_glow.classes: bg-white border border-blue-100 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all rounded-xl

components_instructions.header: Sticky with crystal glass effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70). z-50. Navigation links must hover with text-blue-600. Includes Logo (serif font, bold) and main CTA. Must contain data-testid attributes.
components_instructions.hero_section: Massive serif H1 (Cormorant Garamond). Subtitle in Outfit. Background using the soft blue-to-white gradient ('hero_bg'). CTA button is pill-shaped (rounded-full) with subtle shadow-lg and pure blue bg. Add a subtle floating animation to background elements.

detection_cards.layout: Grid of 3 columns. Each card uses 'crystal_glass' surface style. Generous padding p-8.
detection_cards.text_input: Textarea with 'input_glow' classes. High minimum height (min-h-[150px]).
detection_cards.image_upload: Dashed border (border-2 border-dashed border-blue-200) bg-blue-50/50 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors rounded-xl p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center cursor-pointer.
detection_cards.video_upload: Similar to image upload but distinct icon (Lucide Video). Include preview area styling.

result_card.style: Full width bento box (col-span-full). Crystal glass with thicker white border. Must include a prominent circular progress or large typography for the Confidence Score (e.g., text-6xl for the percentage).
result_card.badges: Green badge (bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200) for REAL, Red badge (bg-red-100 text-red-800 border border-red-200) for FAKE. Use Lucide icons (CheckCircle, XCircle).
result_card.explanation_box: Border-l-4 border-blue-500 bg-blue-50/80 p-6 rounded-r-xl. Include 'Highlighted Suspicious Words' or 'Source Comparison' section.

components_instructions.how_it_works: Grid of 3 steps. Use Lucide icons inside large rounded-full containers (bg-blue-100 text-blue-600). Text left-aligned. High spacing between items.
components_instructions.footer: Generous spacing (py-20). Dark text on light background (bg-slate-50). Simple clean links.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all blue text against light blue backgrounds meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testid: Include data-testid='...' on all interactive inputs, buttons, and result cards.
